title: Cluck's Logical Bamboo
description: I've always thought that it's weird how bamboo blocks are made with 9 bamboo, but look like they are made of 16, So made this to fix it!
body: Ever thought that it's weird that blocks of bamboo are crafted with 9 bamboo but look like they're made of 16? Well I did, So I made this texture pack. If you use this in a video, I would like at least a shoutout to this texture pack.
